description: This file declares functions and constants for managing associated device harvesting parameters, including harvesting status, reporting periods, polling periods, and time-to-live (TTL) for IDW scanning. It defines interfaces for setting and getting various configuration parameters related to associated devices, primarily in a network management context.

methods.name: SetIDWHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Sets the harvesting status (enabled or disabled) for associated devices.

methods.name: GetIDWHarvestingStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the current harvesting status for associated devices.

methods.name: SetIDWReportingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the reporting period (in seconds) for associated devices scan.

methods.name: GetIDWReportingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current reporting period for associated devices.

methods.name: SetIDWPollingPeriod
methods.description: Sets the polling period (in seconds) for associated devices scan.

methods.name: GetIDWPollingPeriod
methods.description: Gets the current polling period for associated devices.

methods.name: SetIDWReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default reporting period for associated devices scan.

methods.name: GetIDWReportingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default reporting period for associated devices.

methods.name: SetIDWPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Sets the default polling period for associated devices scan.

methods.name: GetIDWPollingPeriodDefault
methods.description: Retrieves the default polling period for associated devices.

methods.name: GetIDWOverrideTTL
methods.description: Gets the timeout (TTL) after which the IDW intervals revert to default values.

methods.name: SetIDWOverrideTTL
methods.description: Sets the timeout (TTL) for accelerated IDW scans.

methods.name: GetIDWOverrideTTLDefault
methods.description: Gets the default timeout (TTL) for IDW scans.

methods.name: ValidateIDWPeriod
methods.description: Validates that the provided interval is within the valid range for IDW scans.

methods.name: isvalueinarray
methods.description: Checks whether a given value exists within an array of valid values.
